mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals a strong accommodative monetary policy, which typically leads to increased liquidity in the market and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5 percentage points over the previous month signals economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE increases by more than 0.5pp.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over three consecutive months indicates strong consumer demand, which drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS increases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% month-over-month signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO decreases by more than 1% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is above 8% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) decrease for two consecutive months, it signals a severe labor market weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS decreases for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 8% and PAYEMS decreases for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 0.5% month-over-month signals inflationary pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL increases by more than 0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) over three consecutive months indicates a strong demand for housing, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST increases for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) is below its 12-month moving average and the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2%, it signals a restrictive monetary policy in a weak supply environment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 forward 20-day returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO is below its 12-month MA and FEDFUNDS is above 2%.
